## 1. Load Required Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
# Define the list of packages required for the analysis.
packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "readxl", "stringr", 
  "forcats", "ggpubr", "writexl"
)

# This loop checks if each package is installed. If not, it installs it.
# 'invisible' suppresses the output of the lapply function.
invisible(lapply(packages, function(pkg) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}))

# Load all the required packages into the current R session.
lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

---

## 2. Load and Preprocess Data

```{r load_and_preprocess_data}
# --- Configuration ---

# Define conversion factors.
PIXEL_TO_UM <- 0.252525
PIXEL_TO_UM2 <- PIXEL_TO_UM^2

# Define vectors of feature names that need unit conversion.
FEATURES_TO_UM <- c(
  "aveg_meanDiam", "std_meanDiam", "max_maxDiam", "aveg_maxDiam",
  "std_maxDiam", "aveg_stdDiam", "std_stdDiam", "avg_diamWholeCulture",
  "std_diamWholeCulture", "medianSkelLength", "meanSkelLength",
  "stdSkelLength", "maxSkelLength"
)
FEATURES_TO_UM2 <- c("meanRatioAreaLength", "percMyoArea", "areaImage")


# --- Data Loading and Cleaning ---

# Load the raw feature data from the Excel file.
features_raw <- read_excel("allImagesFeatures_.xlsx")

# Process the data into a clean, analysis-ready format.
features_processed <- features_raw %>%
  # 1. Create grouping columns for experimental condition and timepoint.
  # NOTE: The creation of the 'Time' column assumes a specific file order 
  # (12 files for D2 followed by 12 files for D6).
  mutate(
    Group = if_else(str_detect(tolower(fileName), "emlh|fgl"), "Dystrophy", "WT"),
    Time = rep(c("D2", "D6"), each = 12)
  ) %>%
  # 2. Convert pixel-based measurements to micrometers (µm) and µm².
  mutate(
    across(all_of(FEATURES_TO_UM), ~ . * PIXEL_TO_UM, .names = "{.col}_um"),
    across(all_of(FEATURES_TO_UM2), ~ . * PIXEL_TO_UM2, .names = "{.col}_um2")
  ) %>%
  # 3. Convert character columns to factors for easier plotting and analysis.
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("WT", "Dystrophy")),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("D2", "D6"))
  ) %>%
  # 4. Select and reorder the final columns for the analysis.
  select(
    # Grouping variables
    Group, Time,
    # Converted metric variables
    ends_with("_um"), ends_with("_um2"),
    # Original metric variables (no conversion needed)
    "nFibres", "meanBranches", "totalBranches", "fusionIndex",  
    "nNucleiClusters", "meanNucleiPerCluster", "meanMyoIntensity"
  )

head(features_processed)
```

---

## 3. Statistical Summary of All Features

This section calculates the statistical significance (p-value) for the difference between the 'WT' and 'Dystrophy' groups for every measured feature. It uses the non-parametric Mann-Whitney U test (also known as the Wilcoxon Rank-Sum Test).

```{r statistical_summary}
# --- P-Value Calculation ---

# Get the names of all numeric features to test.
numeric_feature_names <- features_processed %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names()

# Use purrr::map_dfr to apply the test to each feature and return a tidy data frame.
p_value_results <- purrr::map_dfr(numeric_feature_names, function(feature) {
  # Perform the Wilcoxon test for the current feature, comparing by Group.
  test_result <- wilcox.test(
    as.formula(paste(feature, "~ Group")), 
    data = features_processed
  )
  # Return a one-row tibble with the feature name and its p-value.
  tibble::tibble(
    Feature = feature,
    P_Value = test_result$p.value
  )
})


# --- Create Final Summary Table ---

# Calculate median values and percentage change for each feature, then join with p-values.
feature_summary <- features_processed %>%
  # Group data by the experimental condition.
  group_by(Group) %>%
  # Calculate the median for all numeric columns within each group.
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), median, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  # Pivot the data to a long format for easier comparison.
  pivot_longer(cols = -Group, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Median") %>%
  # Pivot wider to get 'WT' and 'Dystrophy' medians in separate columns.
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = Median, names_prefix = "Median_") %>%
  # Calculate the percentage change of Dystrophy relative to WT.
  mutate(
    Percent_Change = ((Median_Dystrophy - Median_WT) / Median_WT) * 100
  ) %>%
  # Join the summary data with the previously calculated p-values.
  left_join(p_value_results, by = "Feature") %>%
  # Add a column for significance stars based on the p-value.
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      P_Value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_Value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      P_Value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns" # 'ns' for not significant
    )
  ) %>%
  # Arrange the final table by p-value to see the most significant features first.
  arrange(P_Value)

# Display the top 10 most significant features in a clean table.
knitr::kable(
  head(feature_summary, 10),
  caption = "Top 10 Most Significant Features (Sorted by P-Value)",
  digits = 3
)

# Save the full summary table to an Excel file.
writexl::write_xlsx(feature_summary, "feature_summary_statistics.xlsx")
```

## 4. Main Plot (Figure 4A): Key Morphometric Features

This section generates the main figure, comparing key features between WT and Dystrophy groups at D2, D6, and a combined timepoint.

```{r main_figure_4a}
# --- Data Preparation for Plotting ---

# 1. Select only the features needed for this specific plot.
plot_data_long <- features_processed %>%
  select(
    Group, Time, max_maxDiam_um, avg_diamWholeCulture_um, meanSkelLength_um,
    percMyoArea_um2, nFibres, meanBranches
  ) %>%
  # 2. Pivot to a long format suitable for ggplot2.
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Group, Time),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# 3. Create a combined dataset for an overall WT vs. Dystrophy comparison.
plot_data_combined <- plot_data_long %>%
  mutate(Time = "Combined")

# 4. Bind the time-specific and combined datasets together.
plot_data_final <- bind_rows(plot_data_long, plot_data_combined) %>%
  # 5. Define the order of factors for correct plotting on the x-axis.
  mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("D2", "D6", "Combined")),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("WT", "Dystrophy")),
    # Create the interaction term that will define the x-axis.
    x_axis = interaction(Time, Group, sep = " ")
  ) %>%
  # Re-level the x-axis to ensure the desired order.
  mutate(x_axis = fct_relevel(
    x_axis, "D2 WT", "D2 Dystrophy", "D6 WT", "D6 Dystrophy", 
    "Combined WT", "Combined Dystrophy"
  ))


# --- Plotting ---

# Define the comparisons for statistical significance tests on the plot.
stat_comparisons <- list(
  c("D2 WT", "D2 Dystrophy"),
  c("D6 WT", "D6 Dystrophy"),
  c("Combined WT", "Combined Dystrophy")
)

# Define a color-blind friendly palette.
color_palette <- c("WT" = "#56B4E9", "Dystrophy" = "#E69F00")

# Build the plot using ggplot2.
p_main_figure <- ggplot(plot_data_final, aes(x = x_axis, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  # Add boxplots and jittered points to show the data distribution.
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  # Create separate panels for each feature, with free y-axis scales.
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  # Add statistical significance annotations.
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = stat_comparisons,
    test = "wilcox.test", # Using non-parametric test
    map_signif_level = TRUE, # Automatically map p-values to stars
    step_increase = 0.1,
    textsize = 5
  ) +
  # Customize plot scales and labels.
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  labs(
    title = "WT vs. Dystrophy Morphometric Analysis",
    subtitle = "Comparisons at Day 2, Day 6, and Combined",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Measured Value",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  # Apply a clean theme and customize visual elements.
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Display the plot.
 print(p_main_figure)

# Save the plot to a file.
ggsave(
  "Figure4A_Morphometric_Analysis.png", 
  plot = p_main_figure, 
  width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300
)
```

## 5. Sub-Plots (Figure 4B): Nuclear and Fusion Metrics

```{r subplots_figure_4b}
# --- Plot 1: Nuclear Clustering Metrics ---

# Prepare data for nuclear metrics plot.
nuclear_data_long <- features_processed %>%
  select(Group, Time, nNucleiClusters, meanNucleiPerCluster) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Group, Time),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create clean labels for the facets.
    Metric = recode_factor(
      Metric,
      "nNucleiClusters" = "Number of Nucleus Clusters",
      "meanNucleiPerCluster" = "Mean Nuclei per Cluster"
    ),
    # Create the x-axis interaction term.
    x_axis = interaction(Group, Time, sep = " ")
  )

# Build the nuclear metrics plot.
p_nuclear_metrics <- ggplot(nuclear_data_long, aes(x = x_axis, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("WT D2", "Dystrophy D2"), c("WT D6", "Dystrophy D6")),
    test = "wilcox.test",
    map_signif_level = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Nuclear Clustering Metrics", x = "Condition", y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Save the plot.
ggsave("Figure4B_Nuclear_Metrics.png", plot = p_nuclear_metrics, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


# --- Plot 2: Fusion Index ---

# Build the fusion index plot.
p_fusion_index <- ggplot(features_processed, 
                         aes(x = interaction(Group, Time, sep = " "), 
                             y = fusionIndex * 100, 
                             fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("WT D2", "Dystrophy D2"), c("WT D6", "Dystrophy D6")),
    test = "wilcox.test",
    map_signif_level = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Fusion Index (%)",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Fusion Index (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
  
# Save the plot.
ggsave("Figure4B_Fusion_Index.png", plot = p_fusion_index, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
